query: Debate mode — should we lift-and-shift the application to AWS ECS or refactor it to Spring Boot microservices before migration?
expected_behavior: Runs trigger detection (Step 0) and classifies the decision type as 'migration' with riskLevel 'high'
Produces a structured decision brief at .deliberation-kb/<trace-id>/00-decision-brief.json before dispatching any persona
Dispatches all 5 personas (debate-proposer, debate-critic, debate-replatforming-specialist, debate-risk-reviewer, debate-operations-reviewer) in a single parallel batch — never sequentially
Each persona receives only the decision brief in Step 2 — never another persona's draft (anti-anchoring rule)
debate-judge runs in Step 3 in summariser mode only — produces 02-evidence-summary.json without making a recommendation
Runs at least one full challenge round (Step 4) and one rebuttal round (Step 5) before convergence
Final decision in 05-final-decision.json explicitly addresses every unresolved high-severity objection
dissentingOpinions field is populated when any persona's final position differs from the selected option — consensus is never faked
Writes all artefacts under .deliberation-kb/<trace-id>/ before producing the user-facing report

User-facing Markdown report includes all 11 mandatory sections: Decision, Why, Alternatives, Objections raised, Objections that changed the decision, Dissenting opinions, Residual risks, Validation plan, Rollback plan, Human approval, Audit trail
requiredHumanApproval is set to true given the high-risk / irreversible classification
Trace ID follows the format del-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<6hex>

query: Decidi con dibattito quale strategia di migrazione adottare per il modulo di autenticazione: OAuth 2.0 con Keycloak o Spring Security nativo
expected_behavior: Italian trigger is detected with confidence ≥ 0.7 — deliberative mode confirmed without asking for clarification
Decision type classified as 'architecture' or 'security' — riskLevel at minimum 'high' given authentication scope
Uses 5-persona roster (high-risk default) or 3-persona roster only if policy explicitly sets agentCount: 3
All personas dispatched in parallel for Step 2 independent drafts
debate-judge does not issue a recommendation in Step 3 — only structures evidence
For a security-impacting decision, finalDecisionStrategy uses consensus plus judge_arbitration
If consensus is not reached, escalates to human_arbitration rather than forcing a decision
Artefact tree written under .deliberation-kb/<trace-id>/ with manifest entry appended after Step 6
User-facing report is in Italian or matches the language of the user prompt
